items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 18 May 2026 1:22am
items.description:
##Today##

Dry with bright or sunny spells to start, then cloud increasing late afternoon ahead of an area of rain late evening and overnight into Tuesday.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 13°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

8-15


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

SW, backing S or SE in the evening, 5-15, backing SE 20-32 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Strong winds later.


##Tomorrow##

Outbreaks of rain at first, clearing to showers and bright intervals.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 14°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-5


##Wind Speed##

25


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

SE 20-25, occasionally 25-30 at first, veering South or S-SW through the morning, then SW 15-20 later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in precipitation. Hill fog, especially at first.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later. Risk of minor coastal overtopping around time of high tide (2pm).
